enrichments.obs_text: The codes of supposing a present fact are G1380 (to think, consider, regard; to think, imagine, suppose, presume) and G3543 (to think, suppose, expect; to suppose, presume, expect, with Luk 2:44 named). The lexicon bears out a belief taken up about what is so, on which the act in Luk 2:44, Joh 11:31, Joh 20:15, Act 14:19, Act 16:27 and Act 27:13 then rests.

The codes of a view held or put to another are G1380 (to think, imagine, suppose, presume), G3543 (to deem, with 1Ti 6:5 named), G3633 (to think, suppose, imagine, presume, with Joh 21:25 and Jam 1:7 named), G5274 (to take up a notion, suppose), G5282 (to suspect, suppose, deem, with Act 13:25 named) and H0559 (to say, to say in one's heart, to think) in 2Sa 13:32 and 2Sa 13:33. The lexicon bears out a view or opinion. G1161 (but, and, then) is a conjunction in the units of 1Cor 8:2 and Jam 4:5 and carries no thinking.

The codes of a case put as a possibility are H0194 (perhaps, peradventure; suppose) in Gen 18:28 to Gen 18:32 and H2009 (behold, lo, see, if) in Eze 18:14. The lexicon bears out particles that open a case and name no act of the mind.

The code of imagining harm is H2803I (to think, plan, devise, mean, invent), whose sense head is devise, plot, plan. The lexicon bears out the planning of the worst against the psalmist in Psa 41:7. H5921A (upon, against) is the preposition in the unit, naming against whom the plan is turned.

The codes of the mind's own picture are H4906 (show-piece, figure, image; imagination, conceit) in Pro 18:11 and G1761 (thought, reflection; the result of thought, invention, device, with Act 17:29 named) in Act 17:29. The lexicon bears out what the mind pictures or devises, a conceit in Pro 18:11 and a design in Act 17:29.
